edges.subject: CLN5
edges.quote: Recent observations suggest that the Batten disease-associated protein CLN5 functions as lysosomal BMP synthase.

edges.subject: CLN5 disease
edges.quote: Overexpression of secreted or cytosolic transacylases was sufficient to correct BMP deficiency in HEK293 cells lacking CLN5.

edges.subject: PLA2G4

edges.subject: endothelial lipase
edges.quote: Extracellularly, acyl-PG and BMP are generated by endothelial lipase in cooperation with other serum enzymes of the pancreatic lipase family.
